title: Lockpicking 1-300
intro: Lockpicking is a Rogue skill: Pick Lock opens locked boxes, chests and doors, and every lock that is not too easy for you raises the skill. The skill can never go past five times your level (100 at level 20, 150 at 30, 225 at 45, 300 at 60), so the guide asks for those levels as it goes.
Pick Lock comes from your class trainer at level 16 and needs Thieves' Tools in your bags. Boxes that mobs drop or that you pickpocket raise the skill too, but the boxes here come back fast.

steps.name: Pick Lock
steps.tip: Any Rogue trainer teaches it; it starts Lockpicking.
A tool: Pick Lock does not work without it in your bags.

at.tip: They come back within seconds. The Jewel of the Southsea in the hold spawns a deadly mob.

steps.tip: From 110 the ones in the water work too.
From 175 the Dented ones count too: a point every time up to 215.
Points all the way to 300; past 290 a point comes less often.
